subject: Learn the DESIGN.md ecosystem as structured visual-design knowledge, not as a blind dependency
parent_goal: Doré visual learning and New Westside product-quality improvement

source.topic: DESIGN.md as an AI-readable design-system layer for coding agents

learning_thesis: README.md explains what a project is; AGENTS.md explains how an agent should develop it; DESIGN.md can encode what the product should look and feel like.
Useful DESIGN.md knowledge includes color, typography, spacing, radius, components, visual language, motion and product-specific style rules.
The highest-value direction for Doré is website/product -> extracted visual language -> structured design knowledge -> Storybook candidates -> browser evidence -> product promotion.

Do not copy fashionable product styles into Westside. Learn extraction methods, schema patterns, visual-analysis methods, and agent-readable representation; preserve Westside identity and locked baselines.

placement.downstream: New Westside candidate generation and visual judgment

required_sequence: Research each listed resource and distinguish reference library, DESIGN.md generator/extractor, inspiration-to-build tool, and implementation utility.
Extract reusable concepts and schemas rather than merely bookmarking URLs.
Compare these concepts against Doré's existing visual-learning, Storybook candidate, provenance, baseline-immutability and WESTSIDE_FIT mechanisms.
Identify concrete gaps where a Doré-native DESIGN.md or equivalent design-memory artifact would improve consistency and agent comprehension.
If justified, propose/implement the smallest Doré-native structured design-memory layer that is generated from evidence and remains subordinate to Westside identity, not external style imitation.
Feed useful findings into the active New Westside parent goal without declaring product PASS from research alone.
Persist durable learning evidence and canonical receipt with source lineage, confidence, accepted/rejected patterns, and downstream reuse points.

special_focus.refero: real-product style systems and AI-readable pattern references
special_focus.getdesignmd: decomposition of real products into color/typography/spacing/components/visual language
special_focus.neuform: screenshot -> visual direction -> DESIGN.md -> agent workflow, especially motion/WebGL/high-visual landing pages
special_focus.aura: compression of inspiration -> analysis -> prompt -> AI implementation

pass_requires: actual research evidence for the resource family
explicit mapping into Doré visual-learning architecture
at least one concrete downstream reuse path for New Westside/Storybook
no false claim that external DESIGN.md equals Westside design truth
forbidden_false_pass: memo-only summary with no reusable knowledge
copying Apple/Linear/Cursor or another brand wholesale
declaring New Westside visually accepted from DESIGN.md research

loop_contract.on_gap: use autonomous learning under single-owner semantics, persist evidence, then resume
loop_contract.on_tool_limit: record bounded evidence and continue with accessible sources rather than inventing findings
loop_contract.on_completion: publish result and reconcile learning into the canonical visual-learning register
